clues: This town sits in a vale at the foot of a big peak. It lies in the west of its land, in a vale with hills on each side.
The cold months here bring snow that falls on the town in drifts. Days stay cold and white, and snow lies on roofs and on the ground.
One year past 1878, when rule came back to this land, this town was picked. It was picked as the chief town of the new Third State of the land.
In one part of this town, three great faiths stand side by side. A church, a mosque, and a house of prayer for Jews all stand close by.
Bulgaria is run from this town, and its work of state is done here. More folk live in this town than in any town in the land.
